fi-pterophyllum-scalare.title: Angelfish
fi-pterophyllum-scalare.summary: The angelfish, Pterophyllum scalare, is a cichlid from the Amazon, Essequibo, Oyapock and other rivers of northern South America. Adults reach 15 cm in body length and 20 cm or more in height, so it…
rows: Omnivore. Omnivorous but wild fish feed predominantly on various items of zoobenthos such as small crustaceans and other aquatic invertebrates.
The natural range of this species covers parts of Colombia, Guyana , Suriname , French Guiana , Peru and Brazil.
notes: Well planted with tall leafy plants such as Amazon Swords.
